C0824.title: Jimo Resident Turns Tables on Fake Leadership Scam
C0824.summary: On September 7, 2021, a Mr. Wang from Jimo received a scam text message impersonating a leader. After adding the scammer on WeChat, the fraudster requested a money transfer under the guise of work and sent a fake remittance slip to pressure him.
